early.name: Sprint Boots
early.annotation: Absolutely one of the best T1 health items in the game. When first bought, gives HP with investment, allows far faster box farming, and better roaming with slight OoC Regeneration. All for § 800 !

mid.name: Active Reload
mid.annotation: Given that your character has a short reload time (Ivy does), this item is great, as you will be allowed to easily proc it to gain very high value stats, such as lots of firerate, movespeed, lifesteal

mid.name: Capacitor
mid.annotation: This item is better the earlier you buy it, B/C Capacitor requires FAR LESS ROF to consistently proc than Tesla Bullets. Its active is a great substitute for ivy losing knockup on ultimate.

mid.name: Healbane
mid.annotation: If planning to be hyper-active in the early game right after capacitor, this can be a good pickup against early healing characters.

mid.name: Bullet Resist Shredder
mid.annotation: Easy to apply with Tesla/Capacitor, and provides a great Bullet Resist Shred debuff while giving spirit investment, and good base stats.

mid.name: Escalating Resilience
mid.annotation: This is a good item to stack more bullet resist, but you are often better off with bullet resilience as replacing this for titanic should not be considered unless you are ultra late game.

late.name: Siphon Bullets
late.annotation: When bought at around 20-25k souls, this item will actually feel effective due to characters starting to be at the 2500-3000HP range. Optimally, you want enemies to be at 3k+HP for this item to SHINE.

late.name: Healing Tempo
late.annotation: Often has more value if you buy this when behind to support other m1s, though you can still retain a fair amount of value from this item due to its abundance of passive stats.
